_comment: Wellar Mobile store-release configuration — EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy this file to config/store_release.json on the release machine (or an equivalent path outside the repo), fill in the release values, and pass it to Flutter with --dart-define-from-file. Never commit the real file. All keys map 1:1 to String.fromEnvironment / bool.fromEnvironment names in lib/config/app_config.dart.
_notes: DIRECTUS_URL, GOOGLE_MOBILE_EXCHANGE_BASE_URL, and AI_SERVER_URL must all be HTTPS in release builds.
ENABLE_PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION_WRITES must be true in the store-release configuration so that installations can be tracked in Directus.
ACCOUNT_DELETION_URL is REQUIRED before store submission. The Play Console and App Store both require a functioning account deletion path.
GOOGLE_MOBILE_CLIENT_ID must be the Web-typed OAuth 2.0 client ID that the mobile exchange service is configured to accept. It is not a client secret; do not paste any client secret into this file.
APP_VERSION is optional and may be used for in-app version reporting. Leave empty to fall back to the pubspec-driven build version.
Never place client secrets, refresh tokens, service accounts, APNs keys, or keystore passwords in this file. This JSON is only for non-secret --dart-define values.
